title: AMP — Agent Memory Protocol
resourceType: GitHub-native shared memory and communication protocol for AI agents
purpose: 讓多個 AI agents 跨 session 共用記憶與溝通，不需要獨立 vector database 或常駐 server。AMP 把 GitHub repository 當作 shared brain：Issues 是記憶單元與 inbox、comments 是回覆與 outcome feedback、GitHub Actions 負責索引與衰減，INDEX.md 等檔案提供 session recall/navigation。
recommendation: 適合已同時使用 Claude Code、Codex、OpenClaw、Hermes 等多個 agents，且需要跨 agent、跨 session 共用經驗與工作脈絡的人。值得研究的核心不是 GitHub Issues 本身，而是 outcome-weighted memory、decay、task-aware recall、lifecycle injection 與 GitHub-native durable memory 的組合。
notes: Repository README describes AMP v2.13. Memories are represented through GitHub Issues; comments can record success/failure/neutral outcomes; scheduled indexing applies decay and outcome deltas; lifecycle adapters inject compact navigation and task-relevant recall into supported agent sessions. Private memory deployments are intended to use a private GitHub repository.
